definitions: An idiom said or performed when one has mentioned some good fortune and wishes to avoid tempting fate, or when one has mentioned some bad fortune and wishes to avoid it happening.
A superstitious gesture to prevent bad luck from occurring after a statement of good fortune or a statement about avoiding misfortune.
examples: I haven't had a cold all year, knock on wood.
We've avoided any major problems so far, knock on wood.
I hope I don't jinx it, knock on wood.
